column1: # The jars the reference recipes run Apache Tika's own code from (`just charsoup-reference` for the CharSoup
# language detector, `just junk-reference` for the JunkDetector and Mojibuster), from Maven Central, then
# SHA-256. The Tika artifacts must be the version extractous-core/tika-native/build.gradle pins. Sources
# jars go to the sources/ directory beside the jars, off the reference recipes' class paths.
